messages:
Aria Chen: hey everyone :wave: quick one — i'm sorting my first-week checklist and not sure where to post a few things: desk/monitor request vs vpn/kms access vs intro message. also which onboarding bots are 'ok' to opt into or should i mute everything? trying not to flood eng channels :grimacing:

Alex (People Ops): welcome Aria! good Q. desk/monitor -> #people-ops (post there with your desk location & monitor preference). vpn/kms/access -> #it-support or DM IT-Bot (they'll give the ticket link). intro message -> post a short intro here in #new-hires and tag your manager. for bots: start with the essentials (hr-notify, slack-join). add deploy-bot or repo-notifs only if you're on infra or a repo team.

Maya (DevEx): adding — if you're unsure, opt out of noisy bots and we can add you later. to see installed apps: /apps. docs and pinned post in this channel list recommended bots for each role. if you do enable repo-notifs, route them to a team channel not #eng.

IT-Bot: Hi Aria! To request hardware fill this form: https://internal/forms/hardware. For VPN/KMS access open a ticket: /it new-access "Please grant VPN + KMS to aria@redwood.ai". Example ticket body:
```
Role: Developer
Access: VPN, KMS (read), S3 dev buckets
Manager: alex@redwood.ai
```
You'll get a ticket link back in DM.

Sam R.: small etiquette note — prefer threads for async discussion, and put a short TL;DR in the parent message. If something needs attention from a specific team, @mention them. Avoid pasting long logs in #new-hires; use a gist or S3 link.

Olivia - Buddy: hi Aria! welcome aboard :tada: happy to jump on a quick intro call. my 15m is free after 2pm. Also: intro template that folks use is one-liner role + 2 things you're excited about + one fun fact. super helpful for the team.

Aria Chen: awesome — thanks all. can someone drop the quicklinks to onboarding docs/pins? can't find pins on mobile. :thinking_face:

Maya (DevEx): pinned post link: https://internal/docs/new-hires/onboarding-quicklinks — includes who-to-ask matrix, bot recommendations, and channel map. i'll paste the who-to-ask snippet here: 
- HR / payroll / badges -> #people-ops
- Hardware / desk -> #people-ops (hardware form)
- VPN / KMS / access -> #it-support or DM IT-Bot
- Repo / CI -> team repo channels or #help-ci
- Incidents / oncall -> #eng-oncall (urgent)

Aria Chen: perfect, saved. one last: if i want GH PR notifications, should i route them to a personal channel or team channel?

Sam R.: team channel. personal channels get noisy and make it hard for reviewers. if it's drafts only, use your own notifications then switch to team channel when ready.

Olivia - Buddy: sending calendar invite for intro now. welcome again! :raised_hands:

Alex (People Ops): ping me if you need expedite for equipment — we'll prioritize first-week essentials.
